action.message: Implemented the fix in src/dotenv/main.py only. In set_key's quoting branch (lines 184-187), backslashes are now escaped before apostrophes: value_to_set.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("'", "\\'"). This ensures the parser's single-quote escape decoding (\\→\, \'→') reproduces the exact original value, so consecutive backslashes and apostrophes round-trip correctly under quote_mode='always' and 'auto'. The quote_mode selection, export handling, and 'never' (unquoted) path are unchanged, preserving existing public behavior. No tests, docs, other modules, or dependencies were modified.
